svg.title: Komorebi-Prism at three levels: machine, frame, core
svg.text: what holds what, and who talks to whom
D0 to D7: the DRAM banks: the scene,
the lists, a frame's pages. X280 0 is
Komorebi's; 1 to 3 run the renderer's threads
one view on the frame's thread: four pulls, one command, two steps on the X280
a frame of 1,920 x 1,080: 60 x 34 tiles, 136 slices of 16 tiles, 2,040 tile threads; a range is 4 blocks of 32 triangles on Sponza
ranges outside the view are skipped; a standing camera runs the tile pull alone; the sums and running sum wait for every core
a Tensix core running a tile thread: five CPUs, one L1, nothing of the tile written but its display page
unpack, math, pack: the steps in order
